acceptance.assertion: A fresh production live-contract run from the intended runner context reaches the designated Weltgewebe frontend and API endpoints far enough to obtain HTTP responses; generic runner-level Network is unreachable no longer prevents observation.

The live-contract check records and validates the production web/API commit or version identity against the expected revision, so a green result proves the intended production revision rather than merely network reachability.

The fix does not weaken production authentication, firewall, private-network, deployment, or GitHub permission boundaries; if the previous runner context is intentionally unable to reach production, the check is moved to an explicitly authorized observation context instead of opening production access.

approval.note: Registered from candidate candidate-2fe6fd9d514ee86233ce97d6 / event 6048 after T048 closeout. Repeated production-live-contract runs failed with Errno 101 Network is unreachable before any HTTP status or commit identity could be observed. Fix the observation path, not the production security boundary.

goal: Restore the Weltgewebe production live-contract check so it can reach the intended production frontend and API, read their HTTP/version identity, and distinguish an actual production contract failure from runner-network unreachability without weakening production network or authentication boundaries.

does_not_establish: that GitHub-hosted runners are necessarily the correct long-term observation context
permission to relax production network controls
permission to mark production healthy without a commit-bound live readback
permission to expose private production endpoints
